work_history.title: Technology and Product Specialist
work_history.description: Building AI systems, products and high-performance teams. With my head in the clouds and my feet on the ground, I'm a product builder driven by creativity, data and purpose. I use my experience in technology, systems architecture and automation to turn ideas into real solutions that create value quickly. When an idea does not hold up, I would rather find out early and stop without wasting time, energy or investment. Today, one of the hardest problems I work on is how to scale engineering teams with AI without lowering the quality bar. I build harnesses, ways of working and closed validation…

work_history.title: Controller
work_history.description: I worked for a few months in Justto's controllership during the final stages of the deal and the transition after it. It was a temporary role focused on keeping the company organized while the transaction was being completed. I already knew the product, the team and the company deeply, so I could connect the financial and operational work with what was really happening in the business.

work_history.title: Co-Founder & CTO
work_history.description: I was co-founder and CTO of Justto. We built the product, the team and the operation from the beginning. My work was not only technology. I was involved in product, architecture, people, delivery, production and the decisions needed to make the company grow with scale. The platform transacted more than BRL 1 billion in legal agreements. We built a strong team, received important awards and the company was acquired by Starian. Before ChatGPT, we were already testing OpenAI models and using them directly in parts of the product.

work_history.title: Senior Systems Architect
work_history.description: I worked as a systems and solutions architect for Muralis and its clients. My role was to understand the problem, define a practical architecture, help the team make technical decisions and follow the solution until delivery. The work included enterprise systems, integrations, Java, Spring, web applications and databases. The exact stack changed according to each client and project.

work_history.title: CTO
work_history.description: I led technology and product as Justto moved from its early stage into a company ready to scale. I was responsible for validating new products and features, turning business goals into practical technology choices and keeping architecture, cloud, software and delivery aligned. What I valued most was working closely with the team, sharing ideas, successes and failures, and building a strong, high-performance culture together.

work_history.title: Co-Founder & System Architect
work_history.description: I joined Justto as a co-founder while the company and the product were still in the early stage. My role was very hands-on: I helped turn the business idea into a product that could operate in the real world. I worked on architecture, backend, frontend, integrations, databases and production. At the same time, I helped shape technical decisions, the first team and the operation that later needed to scale.

work_history.title: System Architect
work_history.description: I worked on mission-critical tolling systems covering the complete operation: lane, toll plaza, back office and management. The systems handled high transaction volumes, vehicle and tag data, communication protocols, financial reconciliation, accounting and ERP integrations. I worked close to both software and hardware, including real-time components with restricted execution windows, resilience and contingency requirements. I followed the engineering of these products from technical decisions to production operation.

work_history.title: Software Development Analyst
work_history.description: I worked as a software analyst and developer, mainly with Java and enterprise systems. I helped write product specifications, implement features, integrate systems and support the development team. This was the period when I built most of my base in mission-critical systems, tolling operations, communication protocols, databases and production support. I started with implementation and progressively took more responsibility for architecture and technical decisions.
